You've got what I asked you for?\nYou can get all of them here in [ffff64]Reug Salt Plains[ffffff].\nThanks in advance.
What brought you here?\n...I see. This is Cule peddlers' camp.\nWell, we can't sell things now though.
We have no time for it during the trip.\nWe don't even have time to chat.\nWe're so sorry.
Oh? You came back?\nI've told you everything I know.\nAnd, I'm busy right now.
Grandma Ryano will have time to...\nOh, but I saw her sleeping.\nWell, why don't you go see her?
What do you want from us?\n...Aha. You look kinda strange.\nYou look like a Hume but something is different...
Eh? Yea, it's a Straye camp but...\nOnly Cules are staying here.
You came all the way here, so you wanna buy\nsomething?\n...That's what I'd like to say but...
We have lots of goods but we can't unpack here.\nSo, we can't sell goods.\nI'm so sorry.
But I'll answer your questions.\nAbout something like...\nthe holy gems you have?
...How did I know, you asked?\nThey smell.\nCules can smell precious things.
Tee hee, now you wanna know their value.\nThanks for... Huh? What are you talkin' about?\nYou can't get information for nothing.
Alright, I won't take money, so...\nCan you collect some items instead?\nAnd I'll give you the info. Deal?
Okay, that's a deal!\nSo, collect the items written here.
You need to hunt monsters.\nThanks!
Oh, listen, the monsters here are pretty tricky.\nSo, watch your back!
Great job! It was hard, wasn't it?\n...Ha ha, you don't need to act tough.
Well, you've collected the items, so\nI'll tell you about holy gems.
You know, dragons and huge monsters that seems to\nhave been modified are appearing these days.\nThey're attacking people.
A holy gem is an artificial magic stone created to\nfight back against those monsters.
You just have to throw it up into the air before\nyou fight them. Then, it'll shatter to pieces and
emit strong magic light that weakens the monsters\nor enhances your ability.
Did you get it? ...What? More details?\nTee hee, I'm sorry.
That's all I know about holy gems.\nI didn't mean to deceive you but...
Oh, yes. Why not ask Ryano the grandma about them?\nShe's near our luggage over there.\nShe's a very knowledgeable person.
Any other questions?\n...The modified dragon?\nI don't really know about it but...
I heard it was so different from the dragons in\nold paintings. Black weird stuff was stuck in its\nbody and it didn't look like a living creature.
Well, you should see how dragons look like with\nyour own eyes.
I heard a dragon appeared in a cave over there.\nWhy don't you go and see?
That's it from me.\nEnjoy your adventures.
Oh, if you see me selling things somewhere,\ntalk to me! I'll give you a discount.
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Oh, hello.\nWhat brought you here?
Oh, I see. You need [ffff64]Purification Incense[ffffff], right?\nBut I'm afraid it's out of stock right now.
I know the materials but...\nAlright, I knew you'd say so.
I wrote down the materials on the note.\nGet these materials and deliver them to [ffff64]Synthesist\nMubia in Sofya City. And she'll make it for you.[ffffff]
Watch your step!
Just get the materials and deliver them to\n[ffff64]Synthesist Mubia in Sofya City[ffffff] so she can make it.
...Looks like she's asleep.
I'm just an old crock.\nWhat do you want from me?
What is a holy gem?
Nothing
...Hmm, a holy gem?\nIt takes a long time to explain. Is that OK?
Yes, please!
I see, forget it...
Alright, listen...\nIt was right after the cataclysm that occurred\nhundreds of years ago...
Unknown monsters appeared everywhere and\na lot of people were killed by them...
The chief god of the twelve gods grieved over\nthe situation and created a gem that has\nmysterious power for people.
It's called the first magic stone or Premiere Gem.\nThe legend says it has protected so many people
in this world as the charm to ward off monsters...\nThe story doesn't end here though.\nYou still wanna listen?
Yes.
Maybe another time...
Alright.\nLet's continue...
A few years ago, a fierce dragon that seems to\nhave been modified by someone appeared with\nhuge monsters and began to threaten people again.
So, the Elves established a new magic research\ninstitution and the magic scholars analyzed\nPremiere Gem to create artificial gems to
drive off the huge monsters...\nThose gems are holy gems...
Phew, it's tiring even just to talk at this age...\nYou still wanna listen to it?
Yes.
No, thank you...
A holy gem is just an imitation of Premiere Gem,\nso it disappears if you use it...
But, they've made great advances in the studies\nand lots of gems with various effects that enhance\nyour ability are being created.
Furthermore, you can easily use them without any\nknowledge about magic, so they spread to warriors\nand adventurers who are not good at using magic.
Now, some merchants are specialized in holy gems.\n...How they create the gems?
Seems like even the merchants don't know.\nPerhaps, only some Resistle people know it...
Phew, that's what I know about holy gems.\nDid you get it? ...That's good.\nCome to me again if you wanna listen to it again.
I see. Then, come to me again when you have time.
I'm just an old crock. What do you want from me?\n...Hmm, a holy gem?\nIt takes a long time to explain. Is that OK?
Yes, please!
I see, forget it...

Unknown monsters appeared everywhere and\na lot of people were killed by them...

Yes.
Maybe another time...

drive off the huge monsters...\nAnd now they're called holy gems...
Phew, it's tiring to speak at this age...\nYou still wanna listen to it?
Yes.
No, thank you...

But, they've made great advances in the studies\nand lots of gems with various effects that enhance\nyour ability are being created.
Furthermore, you can easily use them without any\nknowledge about magic, so they spread to warriors\nand adventurers who are not good at using magic.
Now, some merchants are specialized in holy gems.\n...How they create the gems?
Seems like even the merchants don't know.\nPerhaps, only some Resistle people know it...
Phew, that's what I know about holy gems.\nDid you get it? ...That's good.
Okay, now let me take a nap. I'm a bit tired...\nCome see me if you have something to ask me.\n*yawn* See you.
Alright. Then, come see me when you have time.
You've collected much information from people.
Now let's go to [ffff64]Isthmus of Kaus[ffffff] where a dragon\nwas seen.
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
What's wrong?\n...Naiata? Who?\nI have no idea...
W-Wait, wait.\nThat's it?! Why don't you tell me about that\nperson?
Tell her
Don't tell her
Aw, c'mon! Don't leave me hanging.\nTell me a lil' bit about it. It won't hurt.
Fine! I just won't let you go till you tell me\nabout the person!!
She won't let you go till you tell her...\nYou told her reluctantly that Naiata might be\ncreating holy gems...
Tee hee! I knew it!\nI smelled money when you asked me about Naiata!
Alright! I'll go with you!!\n...Huh? Why? You don't know where she is, do you?
It's really really hard to walk around a strange\nland carrying lots of items alone, you know?
Sounds like she's up to something...
Huh? What's the catch, you said? Come on!\nT-There's no catch... Tee hee!
No no no! Wait!!\nAlright, alright. I'll tell you the truth.
Only Resistle Cules can buy and sell holy gems...\nOh, you know that?
But, I might have the chance to stock them\nif I can negotiate at the place where they\ncreate them, right?
I've been struggling to get the information about\nholy gems and I got nothing.\nNow, a big clue finally emerged.
So, I'm going with you!\nPlease! Take me with you!
She might cause trouble later if you leave her...
Yippee! Just a minute.\nI'll make preparations right now!
Thanks for waiting! Okay, now let's go.\nHuh? Where to?\nOh, right. We don't know where she is.
Then, let's ask Grandma Ryano.\nHurry!
...You're going with this adventurer?\nResistle people are hard headed.\nI don't think they lend an ear to what you say.
It may end up in vain. You hate it, right?
You said I have a glib tongue like yours!\nYou said I can persuade anyone, didn't you?!
Hmm... Yes, but...\nOkay, I know you never go back on your word.\nAdventurer, you shouldn't have told her about it.
Well, I haven't heard of the mage called Naiata,\nbut if you head north, there's a place called\nScaro where Resistle people gather.
Why don't you ask the people there about her ?\nWell, be careful on the way.
So... She's still here.\nI thought she already went somewhere.\nWhat is she doing... Grandma? Grandma!
Grandma!
Ohh, welcome back.\nIt's been so long. Where have you been?
What are you talking about?!\nI told you I would go with\nthis adventurer, didn't I?!
By the way, why is the caravan still here?!\nYou're gonna go bust!
Do not yell like that.\nWe're here because strange crystal monsters are\nwandering around here...
Crystal monsters?\nThe adventurer drove them off.
Oh, ah,  yea?\nY-You know the fierce dragon is...
The adventurer defeated it...
Wha...
Um, ah, the truth is...\nI like to stay here.
W-Whaaat?!\nHow are you gonna earn money?!
You know it's not really far from Sofya City.\nWe have various ways to do business.
It's right but...\nHmm, fine.
Oh, yes. I wanted to ask you about something!\nJust a moment...\nDo you know what it is?
Let me see... Hmm, I've never seen it.\nWas it in the ruins?
I've seen many old things but...\nI've never seen this one.
Hmm, the investigation is back to square one\nif you don't know it...
Oh, if you want to know about something old,\nwhy not look it up [ffff64]at the library in Sofya[ffffff]?
Oh, right. It didn't even cross my mind...\nThanks, grandma.
I'll continue traveling with this adventurer.\nIf you move from here, tell someone in Sofya\nabout where you will be going.
You're always in a hurry.\nDon't bother the adventurer, okaaay?
